title: Revisiting Accent Classification with DistilHuBERT: Speaker-Disjoint Evaluation and Cross-Corpus Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.13440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent accent classification systems can achieve high accuracy in standard in-corpus evaluations. However, when speakers overlap between the training and test sets, such results may overestimate model robustness compared with real-world deployment scenarios. This study revisits the robustness of DistilHuBERT-based accent classification by using L2-ARCTIC and multiple external English accent datasets. The comparison covers file-level and speaker-disjoint splits, along with balanced external-data training and teacher-student pseudo-labeling. The large performance gap between in-corpus and external evaluations suggests that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates performance, while speaker-disjoint evaluation can provide a more realistic estimate of the generalization to unseen speakers. translated_title: 基于DistilHuBERT重访口音分类：说话人分离评估与跨语料库泛化
translated_abstract: 最近的口音分类系统在标准的语料库内评估中可以达到很高的准确率。然而，当训练集和测试集之间的说话人存在重叠时，与真实部署场景相比，这样的结果可能高估了模型的鲁棒性。本研究使用L2-ARCTIC和多个外部英语口音数据集，重新审视了基于DistilHuBERT的口音分类的鲁棒性。比较涵盖了文件级和说话人分离的数据划分，以及平衡的外部数据训练和师生伪标签方法。语料库内评估和外部评估之间的巨大性能差距表明，文件级评估大大高估了性能，而说话人分离评估能为模型对未见说话人的泛化提供更贴近现实的估计。在本研究中，仅用外部数据训练的模型无法可靠地泛化到L2-ARCTIC。在所测试的配置中，平衡的外部……
tldr: 该研究发现文件级评估会大幅高估基于DistilHuBERT的口音分类模型性能，说话人分离评估才能更真实地反映模型对未见说话人的泛化能力，且仅用外部数据训练的模型难以可靠泛化到L2-ARCTIC语料库。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates DistilHuBERT-based accent classification performance, speaker-disjoint evaluation provides a more realistic estimate of generalization to unseen speakers, and models trained solely on external data fail to reliably generalize to L2-ARCTIC.
